svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Agentic Robotics and Industrial Vision: research map
svg.desc: Agents that plan, coordinate and inspect. Sub-problems: LLM task planning (How does a goal become a graph of subtasks?); Human–robot coordination (Who does what, and when?); Industrial safety agents (Can robots find hazards with no people on site?); Industrial vision (Can low-cost cameras find tiny defects and locate parts?). Open questions: Agents that recover when a plan fails; Reliable vision on low-cost hardware; From simulation to the factory floor.
